question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing benchwarmer, Bob is playing striker, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing goalkeeper, Eve is playing right winger, Fred is playing fullback, and Gertrude is playing center midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Dave and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) benchwarmer
(B) striker
(C) cheerleader
(D) goalkeeper
(E) right winger
(F) fullback
(G) center midfielder
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: benchwarmer, striker, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right winger, fullback, center midfielder
1. Eve ↔ Fred: benchwarmer, striker, cheerleader, goalkeeper, fullback, right winger, center midfielder
2. Alice ↔ Bob: striker, benchwarmer, cheerleader, goalkeeper, fullback, right winger, center midfielder
3. Claire ↔ Gertrude: striker, benchwarmer, center midfielder, goalkeeper, fullback, right winger, cheerleader
4. Bob ↔ Dave: striker, goalkeeper, center midfielder, benchwarmer, fullback, right winger, cheerleader
5. Alice ↔ Dave: benchwarmer, goalkeeper, center midfielder, striker, fullback, right winger, cheerleader
6. Eve ↔ Gertrude: benchwarmer, goalkeeper, center midfielder, striker, cheerleader, right winger, fullback
7. Dave ↔ Alice: striker, goalkeeper, center midfielder, benchwarmer, cheerleader, right winger, fullback
Gertrude is playing fullback, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
